Plus the Bondi Vet meets some amazing women and finds out how their beautiful beads are saving wildlife.
Chris and Lisa head to fire-ravaged Blue Mountains to help stranded animals. Chris treats a premature baby alpaca whose mum went into early labor during evacuation. The newborn cria is fading fast.

p.d: In Kazakhstan, a convoy carrying advanced nanotech warheads is attacked. Rescued by an elite military unit, two soldiers join the team as they track a criminal group behind the assault, uncovering a deeper conspiracy.```.
The IMF is shut down when it's implicated in the bombing of the Kremlin, causing Ethan Hunt and his new team to go rogue to clear their organisation's name.
Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating a highly skilled international rogue organisation that is committed to destroying the IMF.
An extraterrestrial finds a friend in 10-year-old Elliot, while members of a task force work day and night to track down the whereabouts of Earth's first visitor from outer space.
A quick-witted terrier finds his position in the household threatened when his master brings home a stray mongrel with no polish.
Terrier Max is back and is coping with some major life changes. This new chapter explores the emotional lives of our pets, the deep bond between them and the families that love them.
A secret agent is sent to Sydney to find and destroy a genetically modified disease called Chimera.
When aliens discover video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack the Earth, using the video games as the models for their assaults.
Peter Parker, the beloved superhero Spider-Man, faces four destructive elemental monsters while on holiday in Europe. Soon, he receives help from Mysterio, a fellow hero with mysterious origins.
When a spell goes wrong, dangerous foes from other worlds start to appear, forcing Peter to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

p.t: Shorebreak: The Series - Welcome to the North Shore
p.d: S1 E1Hawaiian photographer Clark Little introduces us to his home-Oahu’s North Shore-where he captures the wonder of the waves through his lens.

S1 E4North Shore funny-man and barrel specialist Tamayo Perry takes us on a unique journey to the beautiful south pacific islands of Tahiti.  While in Tahiti, Tamayo surfs in the Von Zipper Trials of the Billabong Pro at one of the world’s heaviest breaks known as, Teahupo'o.  After exploring the natural beauty of the islands, Tamayo catches some of the biggest and most intense waves to hit Teahupo'o in years.  <br />.

S2 E5Firsthand catches up with Rochelle Ballard, runner-up champ of 2004 WCT ASP, as she heads into the fifth stop of the WCT women's tour in Perranporth, England.  Faced with bitter cold water temperatures and volatile surf conditions, Rochelle surfs her way through the first two rounds but falls short in the Quarterfinals losing to up and comer, Rebecca Woods.  With a week off before the next contest, Rochelle takes advantage of the downtime and travels to picturesque Biarritz, France, where she immerses herself in the French culture, food and of course her favorite pastime, shopping!  Firsthand picks back up with Rochelle in her home state of Kauai, Hawaii, relaxing with family and friends and taking a stroll down memory lane at her childhood surf spot, PKs.

TAPS travels to Holliston, Massachusetts to help a family that has a spirit haunting their home.
The team return to Jason's hometown to meet a woman whose son is being physically attacked by an evil spirit.
TAPS answers an urgent call from a homeowner who is being plagued by a disturbing spirit.
A frightened family in Glen Gardner, New Jersey calls TAPS for assistance from a menacing shadowy figure.

When Jason and Grant take the TAPS team on a visit to St. Augustine, Florida, to examine a lighthouse where a man hanged himself on the front porch, they manage to capture an audio recording of a woman's voice saying the words help me.
TAPS heads to Roselle Park, New Jersey to investigate an Italian restaurant plagued by a deceased owner.
TAPS travels to Guthrie, OK to investigate The Stone Lion Inn, a bed and breakfast with paranormal phenomenon.
The Stanley Hotel, inspiration for Stephen King’s “The Shining”, is the setting for this TAPS investigation.

Donna suggests that the TAPS team travel to Tombstone, Arizona, in order to investigate the possibility of paranormal activity at the Birdcage Theater, a former drinking and burlesque hall that is the only remaining original building in the town.
TAPS continue their investigation into the paranormal history of the old west by heading to Bisbee, Arizona to uncover the secrets at The Copper Queen Hotel.
The team travels to a Vermont home and investigates the closed West Virginia State Penitentiary in Moundsville, West Virginia to investigate phenomena attributed to shadow people.
In Massachusetts, TAPSexplores a Victorian mansion with a bizarre history of unexplained activity.

The legendary hotel that served as inspiration for Stephen King's horror novel The Shining has an extensive history of mysterious and unexplainable phenomena, such as reports of the sounds of children playing in the halls on the fourth floor.

Jason and Grant head to Ireland to investigate Leap Castle, considered by many to be one of the most haunted places in the world. One of the spirits in the castle is an elemental that was supposedly summoned by dark arts, and is reported to be hostile and perhaps even deadly.
Continuing their investigation in Europe, TAPS explores the mysterious Lisheen Ruinsin Ireland.

TV4DADS is a television series dedicated to fathers and father figures around the world. This exciting series features solid teaching, fun and adventure! In season three, the team head to Alaska for the ultimate Dad's adventure.

In the heart of Toowoomba, Barb Blewett is redefining the meaning of welcome. Her tireless efforts to support Yazidi refugees show how simple acts of kindness can transform a strange land into a true home. Join Barb as she bridges cultural divides and creates a sense of belonging that transcends language and borders.

Peter talks with Dr Daryl Holmes from 1300 Smiles about the importance of moving from strategy and planning to executing. Peter and the team explore how by being willing to take steps, even if the plan isn’t perfect, valuable opportunities arise to adjust the plan to gain greater results.

Dominating the landscape for centuries, ancient cathedrals and abbeys reflect Britain's turbulent history through their architectural grandeur. A Pilgrimage through Britain's Great Cathedrals explores cathedrals and abbeys found throughout England and Wales, featuring interviews with historians and experts and breathtaking footage of the cathedrals' legendary facades and soaring interior spaces.

p.t: Walking in the Footsteps of Faith
p.d: It all started with the blending of three passions: a passion for History, a passion for Adventure and a passion for Faith Works and teaching! Steve Faucette always dreamed of hosting a show and sharing it with the world. Discover how giants of the faith like Mother Theresa, Martin Luther, and David Livingston lived following Steve, walking in their footsteps!

A panel of women get together to share their lives, struggles, families, And the joy that occurs throughout their daily lives, And they also want to dig deeper to build a sense of community where they can work on relationships And their faith.

Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.

Jericho was a highly fortified city, yet conquered by the Israelites in dramatic fashion. The Bible reveals God's power through the unique circumstances of the Israelites' conquest of Jericho. While the fall of Jericho captures the imagination of many, the story of Rahab is just as captivating. Jericho: City of Rahab captures the essence of her life in a way that will encourage and inspire you.

Katherine Ruonala shares a practical message of love and hope to the nations. Reaching across denominational walls, her ministry is used to spread the fires of revival and ignite a fresh passion in the hearts of believers to go deeper in their relationship with God. Katherine carries a strong prophetic and miracle anointing with many experiencing instant healing in her meetings.
You can go to church every week and still miss what it means to truly know God. Today, Joyce explains the difference between religious routine and a real relationship with Him.

When Mr Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate’s self-destructive behaviour, Deen quickly discovers a host of dark secrets slowly tearing Nate apart. What began as a good deed becomes a desperate fight to save Nate from his own demons. As Nate spirals deeper into despair, Deen must decide how far he’s willing to go to save a kid on the brink of losing everything—even himself.

NYC boss Lindsey hits a charming Irish town to snag land for a resort. Between the local festival and handsome local Brennan, she's torn. In the big smoke or a small town, she reckons following her heart might be her luckiest move yet.

A busy surgeon heads back home to celebrate her father becoming mayor. But after a chance encounter with the town's only doctor-and most eligible bachelor-she witnesses true compassion which might be the prescription this doctor needs.

Will Faith Do Us Part? reveals the intimate stories of three interchurch couples who are dealing with the challenges of being united with a spouse who is no less devoted to Jesus, yet has different beliefs and faith practises.

Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.

With only 30 minutes and the clock ticking, can Vanessa make an allergen friendly meal for 4 for about 40 bucks? On the menu: kale and lentil salad with green goddess dressing, chickpea curry, and avocado key lime pie cups!

Chef Dev shares recipes for international street food dishes that take inspiration from other countries, including a Mexican-inspired British Burrito, American-inspired Korean Fried Chicken, and Indian-inspired Guyanese Duck Curry.

Unlock Gusto TV's top recipes on QR Countdown! Thousands of viewers scan our QR codes to access our delicious dishes. Now. we're serving up 8 of our most popular recipes featuring honey. from hosts like Shahir Massoud and Jessica McGovern.

Unlock Gusto TV's top recipes on QR Countdown! Thousands of viewers scan our QR codes to access our delicious dishes. Now. we're serving up 8 of our most popular and unique recipes from shows like A is for Apple and CombiNation Plates!

Maddie and Kiki fire up the BBQ Barn for a smoky, summery feast with wild rice and grilled asparagus salad, spicy beer can jerk chicken, sweet grilled corn with orange butter, and crispy cinnamon sugar doughnuts.
Maddie and Kiki bring a fresh BBQ Barn feast to the grill with apricot-Dijon stuffed pork chops, charred fennel with anchovy garlic butter, and a juicy watermelon salad with feta, olives, and herbs.
BLITZ! is an all-new cooking show! Imagine being next to Eva Bee as they cook their fav dishes!

Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Your Pasta Sucks: A “Cookbook” by comedian Matteo Lane! Follow along as Shahir prepares eggplant parmigiana, pasta alla pesto trapenese, and risotto allo zafferano!
Piemonte cuisine is influenced by its mountainous terrain. Chef Michael Bonacini shows us how to make its warm regional dishes like Bagna Cauda.
Aspiring kid Chefs make avocado toast and tacos, Liam whips up an easy pantry pasta, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a favorite one pot meal!

Aspiring kid Chefs prep rainbow fruit skewers, Liam whips up his charity-inspired cheeseburger soup, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a popular Trinidadian street food, fried bread and saltfish!
Aspiring kid Chefs make pancakes, Liam whips up craveable chicken coconut curry, Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make Nashville fried chicken sandwiches, and more!

Aspiring kid Chefs test kitchen hacks with eggs, Liam whips up the beef and broccoli stir fry he made for friends as a kid, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a beautiful pistachio pasta and Caesar salad!
Chef and seafood expert Spencer Watts shows how vinegar, a simple pantry staple, can bring out the flavours of walleye, lobster, and crawfish.
Seafood lover and chef Spencer Watts brings the party to the kitchen and shows that cocktails aren’t just for drinking, they’re also an inspiration for cooking great seafood.

Corine Carey, Leanne Sallenback, and Kelly Ireland travel to San Antonio, Texas, to answer the panicked calls of local residents who have experienced paranormal phenomena tied to the infamous Battle of the Alamo in 1836.

Corine, Leanne, and Kelly travel to Montreal to answer calls from frightened witnesses who are being haunted by ghosts related to the city's turbulent history from the early 1900's through to the end of the Prohibition in the 1930's.
Find out how deep a mother’s love can go with these ghostly encounters.
Meet ghosts who died from traumatic circumstances, including a famous disaster.
See how a happy family is broken after enduring a year in a haunted house.
See how people’s supernatural experiences have haunted them for life.
Meet two people who have strange encounters reminiscent of popular folk tales.
See how Tasheen and Christine react when spirits warn them of imminent danger.
Meet a couple in a century-old farmhouse still occupied by its original owner.
See what happens when people venture onto trails frequented by the deceased.

Legend says Ashmore Estates is shrouded in shadows and mystery. But as the team investigates, they uncover a haunting with a purpose; one that runs deeper than ghost stories and reveals a reason that changes everything.

Return to Ashmore Estates with the team and follow the trail to Robbin Terry’s home, the R Theater. Witness eerily similar paranormal activity, which points to another mysterious connection and a shocking revelation that no one saw coming.

Tour the infamous Pauly Jail in Union Springs, Alabama, where Shane once had a life-changing experience. Listen as chilling voices echo through the abandoned cells, and spirits desperate to share their secrets stalk the investigative team.

p.t: Celebrity Help! My House Is Haunted
p.d: Comedian and writer, Dom Joly, has heard eerie opera singing coming from his son's bedroom. Jayne uncovers a fascinating historical music connection.

p.t: Celebrity Help! My House Is Haunted
p.d: A shadowy female figure haunts Shaun Williamson's Isle of Sheppey home. A violent spectrum appears during a spirit-trigger session, and a wife killer's soul may be destroying the peace.
The thirteen contestants must prepare breakfast for fifty hungry EMTs. The winning team enjoy a poolside lunch and a trip to trapeze school while the losers are on cleaning duty.

The chefs created their own ravioli including pasta, filling and sauce. After judging by Ramsay, the winning team took a helicopter trip to a coastal resort to play golf, and the losing team cleaned the kitchens and milked cows.

The chefs prepare a tasting menu of an appetizer and two main dishes for the Beverly Hills High School prom committee; the women visit Knott's Berry Farm and the men cleaned the kitchens and helped the prom committee put up decorations.

Chef Ramsay moves some of the team members around before the new groups are challenged to come up with a special salad dish, with the best meal being featured in a magazine; at evening service, things start badly and then get worse.

The teams are asked to create a dish made from ingredients chosen by the spin of a roulette wheel. The team who make the best meal are sent on a luxury trip to Las Vegas. Dinner service is a family event, complete with clowns and games, and the guests include members of Gordon's family as well as talk show host Jerry Springer. Can the contestants manage to impress their famous diner?
The teams must shop on a budget and prepare elegant dishes for four judges. The winners go sailing and dancing while the losers fumigate Hell's Kitchen.
Teams face a blind taste test. Can they identify the ingredients? Winners get a shopping spree and a slap-up dinner. A disastrous service sees Ramsay chuck multiple chefs out. Who's eliminated?

The seven remaining chefs tackle lobster, chicken and salmon, but each gets only five minutes alone in the kitchen. Winners score a shopping spree and top restaurant meal. At dinner service, diners choose between team menus. Who goes home?

Contestants have 20 minutes to make five portions of an amuse-bouche, judged by five local chefs. Winners lunch at the prize restaurant. At dinner service, sports stars Nomar Garciaparra and Mia Hamm drop in.

The remaining contestants must produce 80 portions of a lunch dish to serve from their own food truck. The person whose meal is the most well-received will be given a makeover while the others are left on cleaning duty. At dinner service, Paris Hilton is in attendance, but will her presence inspire the hopefuls to up their game?

The chefs are challenged to recreate a dish using only sight, smell and taste, and the losers must complete laundry duty; the chefs find their groove and manage to delight Ramsay with the smoothest dinner service to date.

Contestants create fusion dishes using ingredients from eight different cuisines. The winner scores lunch at top restaurant Spago. At dinner service, the hopefuls struggle on the pass. Who makes it to the final?
The two finalists cook five dishes at LA Market, where the winner will work. At their final dinner service, eight returning contestants help out, but there are no sous chefs. Who takes the crown?

New series of Gordon Ramsay's American cooking competition. 18 chefs compete for the prize of a head chef position at Gordon Ramsay Steak at the Paris Las Vegas in Paradise, Nevada. In the first episode, the contestants make a dramatic arrival at Hell's Kitchen before being split into teams for the signature dish challenge. When it is time for the first evening service, the teams have very different approaches, but there are struggles on both sides which lead to firm action from Chef Ramsay.

Take in the moving stories of those who experienced the ferocity of German bombing, as the Luftwaffe targeted the major cities of Britain.

By May 1940, the die was cast and the war started in earnest. This episode examines the buildup to the Battle of Britain, studying the technological advances that the RAF pioneered, to the start of the Battle itself. At the heart of the RAF production were two world-class fighters, the Hurricane and the Spitfire, which were able to compete against the best the Luftwaffe had to offer.

This episode focuses on events from July to early September, 1940. The Germans tried initially to bomb British naval shipping with limited success. However, three separate attacks in August targeting RAF airfields were successful. Biggin Hill, North Weald, and Kenley were all temporarily put out of action. Then, the Germans made a mistake that ultimately lost them the war.

During the first week of September, Hitler decided to move the bombing strategy away from the airfields, to civilian London. This episode examines the spirit of the Londoners who defied Hitler, and ultimately ended the war in the last weeks of September. The RAF, with fewer resources, fewer men, and fewer machines, had beaten the might of the Luftwaffe.

The MythBusters investigate if it's possible to unblock a toilet with molten salt. The results are explosive, but has this salt really got game to fix your throne?
Will a toilet filled with bug spray explode? If not, what does it take to make a toilet explode in the manner described in this popular myth?
Can cell phones cause dangerous gas station fires? Can a change in atmospheric pressure, experienced while flying have an effect on breast implants? And can CDs shatter in very high-speed drives?
Jamie and Adam recreate a widely known construction industry myth. Plus, can peeing on the third subway rail lead to electrocution? And can an eel skin wallet demagnetise credit cards?
The Myth: that a penny dropped from the top of the Empire State Building will be embedded in the concrete or asphalt below. If it strikes a poor pedestrian, it will shatter their skull and kill them.

Jamie buries Adam alive to see how long he can survive six feet under. Can cola be used as a cleaning fluid? Could a person survive a sixty metre fall from a bridge by using a hammer to break the surface of the water?

Mikey was challenged by his friends to eat six packs of POP Rocks Candy and Six cans of Soda. The carbon dioxide that makes the candy pop combined with the carbon dioxide in the soda to create so much pressure his stomach exploded.
Does wearing a tongue stud increase your chances of being struck by lightning? Can you build a a cannon out of a tree? And Adam and Jamie set out to bust the myth that you can fool the breathalyser.

What happens when a redneck faces off with a raccoon? According to this myth a drunken “good ole boy” poured gasoline down a drain to try and flush out a raccoon he was chasing. He crawled down the drain to light the gas and... boom!
In this episode, Jamie and Adam test out a world famous San Francisco myth, the escape from Alcatraz.

Jamie Hyneman and Adam Savage find out if launching a chicken at an airplane will disrupt its flight and if a washing machine can really be deadly. They also explore the myth of the woman who swallowed an octopus egg then gave birth to an eight-legged offspring.

Special effects experts Adam Savage and Jamie Hyneman conduct experiments to try to determine if a person can become trapped in an airline toilet, if the biscuit bazooka really exists, and the truth behind the legend of the leaping lawyer.

The Changeling: Undergoing an experiment that could end his need for a symbiote, Teal'c is trapped in a dreamlike world that features all the characters from Stargate's past.

SG-1 accompanies the X-53 on its voyage into deep space. When the ship drops out of hyperspace, SG-1 is stranded with no means of getting back to Earth. Their only option lies in exploring a nearby planet where a Stargate is thought to be located.

SG-1 encounters a civilization desperate to be freed from the clutches of a Goa'uld. While on the planet, Jonas falls ill. His illness is diagnosed as a brain tumor but it gives him the ability to see the future...where SG-1 are walking into a trap!
SG-1 is called to defend the people of Abydos from the Goa'uld once again when they learn that Anubis is about to attack.
As SG-1 begins its search for the Lost City, they discover that Jackson has been returned by the Ancients.
As Anubis prepares to attack Kelowna and steal the Naquadria, Teal'c asks Ba'al to lead a revolt against the rogue System Lord.
When a teenage boy claiming to be Colonel O'Neill turns up at the SGC, the team begin an investigation into what happened and why. Unfortunately, time is not on young Jack's side.
After an injury, Teal'c must put aside his self-doubt when SG-1 launches a mission to rescue his son and his mentor from a Jaffa death camp.
The team gates to a climate-controlled environment amidst a toxic wasteland, whose people are all linked to a central computer.

While investigating a crashed ship, SG-1 finds hundreds of inhabited pods. While counting, they are all knocked unconscious. Upon returning to SGC, Daniel insists on getting back to the ship and appears to not know where he is nor who anyone else is.

Daniel reunites with former comrade Chaka in a bid to reach a peaceful compromise as SG-3 prepares to do battle with the Unas over a Naquadah mine. Sci-fi drama, starring Richard Dean Anderson and Michael Shanks.
An alien proposes to share his planet's technology in exchange for Carter helping him win a space race.

An SGC scientist creates a computer virus that can be utilized to shut down enemy Stargates, but he accidentally crashes the entire gate network; a System Lord attempts a power play while all of the Stargates are disabled.

SG-1 encounters a race of women warriors whose survival depends on symbiotes harvested from Jaffa. Teal'c and SG-1 must convince the warriors' high priestess to put aside her fear of reliance on a life-saving drug before the Goa'uld destroy them.

SG-1 encounters a very advanced bio-engineered warrior endowed with super strength, created by Anubis. While the team sets out to locate the origin of this new foe, Daniel travels to South America in search of a device left on Earth by the Ancients.

As the top boats battle it out for Bluefin Supremacy, Captain Paul gets back on the water for the first time since the incident with Doug in hopes of salvaging his season. Af-ter an unsuccessful attempt at fishing solo Paul calls in a former mate to help him out, assuring him he has learned from his mistakes and is ready to be a better Captain.

The Gloucester captains race to catch bluefin tuna before an impending storm chases them off the water. Meanwhile, former five-time champion Dot Com searches for a monster fish to climb out of third place. With the storm getting closer, how much is Captain Dave Carraro willing to risk to finally reclaim his crown.

As the season comes into the home stretch, the battle for Wicked Tuna’s top spot is hotly contested. Four boats are all within one fish of the lead, and are fishing harder than ever. The captain of the Moonshine tries to will his crew to a profitable season, while Pinwheel fights to stay in the race. And after a season of hard times and heartbreak, the Hot Tuna gets a shot at redemption.
It is a neck-and-neck race for the top spot. The crews must come u pwith strategies to succeed as an announcement about the quota closing is due any day now.

As the quota runs out and the season ends, Gloucester’s best Bluefin fishermen have only one day left to strike blue gold and get their last paychecks, but it’s down to the four top boats – Time Flies, FV-Tuna.com, Hard Merchandise, and Fat Tuna - to push their limits and battle it out for the championship title.
As the Bluefin season opens, the battle for the first fish and to become the 'G.O.A.T.' or 'Greatest Of All Time' kicks into high gear. U.
Viral video star and Captain of Fishing Vessel No Limits Michelle Bancewicz joins the Wicked Tuna ranks, and begins her tenure in spectacular fashion.
The bluefin bite is on and one Captain seeks redemption, to gain favor with the tuna gods, and deliver a winning season. But is atonement enough?
The competition heats up and alliances form, as some boats are willing to make the 90-mile steam to Chatham and some are not.
Wicked Pissah joins Fat Tuna, Hot Tuna And Time Flies in Chatham, hoping there is strength in numbers. Meanwhile Tyler continues fishing on his own.

After spending most of the season badmouthing the fleet for fishing in Chatham, captain Tyler has a change of heart, and decides to chase the bite down south. No Limits also decides to follow the fleet to the Cape with the hopes of climbing up from the bottom of the leaderboard. Will the gamble and long steam pay off?
Hard Merchandise is forced to deal with its captain’s health issues and simultaneously take on one of its biggest fish fights of the season.

With too many bluefins getting caught, the quota diminishes, the market gets flooded, and captains worry the only remedy may be a buyer shutdown; Capt. Krasowski of the Fish Hawk and his fellow anglers out of Gloucester fish like there's no tomorrow.
After buyers took a much-needed break to relieve their inventory and improve the health of the market, the fleet is back on the hunt for blue gold.

North Atlantic bluefin season nears the halfway point and prompts Ott family fishing vessel Bad Fish to join the hunt. Tim Ott, Sr. along with brother-in-law Chris Spike McGovern, fish alongside sister vessel Hot Tuna in the hopes of bringing home two paychecks for the family business. Meanwhile, new rivalries form within the fleet as boats scramble for their share of wicked tuna.
